headline: NHL trade board 3.0: Rumor mill in high gear after Nikita Kucherov's seismic trade request
take:
The Athletic reports that Nikita Kucherov has requested a trade from the Lightning, and Daily Faceoff says he addressed it publicly for the first time on Monday, calling it a result of "poor communication and respect." The Athletic also quotes him saying Tampa Bay "made it clear that I'm free to walk on July 1," and cites one NHL GM estimating "31 teams" would pursue him if he's available.

Whatever the dispute, the on-ice case for him holds up. So far this season he has 4 goals and 14 assists in 13 games, and his own expected goals (a measure of the quality of his chances) come to 4.18 against 4 actual goals, so he's scoring about what his shots warrant. TBL controls 59% of the expected goals at five-on-five with him on the ice, and the team's share is about six points better with him out there than without him. Tampa Bay sits 8-3-2, and its expected-goals share of 56% says the record is earned. The weak spot is goaltending, where the team is 4 goals saved below expected, so Kucherov is driving a good team, not propping up a poor one.
